_comment: Ground truth for SEMANTIC (vector) retrieval over the Treasure Island fixture.
Every query is phrased to describe a scene CONCEPTUALLY while deliberately
avoiding the distinctive vocabulary the passage itself uses. 'a ragged
castaway who has survived alone for years' must find the Ben Gunn chapter
without sharing the words 'marooned', 'maroon' or 'Gunn' with it.
This is the point of the fixture: a BM25 arm cannot answer these, and
neither can a degraded FNV-1a hash embedder, because hashing carries no
meaning. Only a real sentence embedder can. The test asserts the gap
between the semantic embedder's hit rate and the hash embedder's, so it
fails loudly if semantic search silently degrades.
`expect_chapters` is satisfied if ANY listed chapter appears in the top-k.
`avoid_terms` are words the query must NOT contain — asserted by the test
so that nobody can later 'fix' a failing query by leaking the answer's

queries.name: eavesdropped_mutiny
queries.query: a young lad hidden inside a cask secretly learns the sailors plan to turn against their officers
queries.note: Ch 11 — Jim hides in the apple barrel and overhears Silver recruiting for the mutiny.

queries.name: lone_castaway
queries.query: a ragged solitary castaway who has survived by himself for three years on an empty shore
queries.note: Ch 15 — Ben Gunn, three years alone on the island.

queries.name: digging_for_riches
queries.query: the party digs in the ground hunting for wealth hidden long ago by a dead buccaneer
queries.note: Ch 31-33 — the treasure hunt following Flint's directions.

queries.name: parley_terms
queries.query: the opposing leader walks up to the fort wanting to bargain and settle the quarrel
queries.note: Ch 20 — Silver's Embassy; he comes to the stockade to make terms.

queries.name: duel_aloft
queries.query: a struggle to the death high above the deck while scrambling up the mast
queries.note: Ch 26 — Jim and Israel Hands fight in the rigging.

queries.name: frightening_lodger
queries.query: a rough old sailor rents a room at a quiet seaside tavern and terrifies everyone there
queries.note: Ch 1-2 — Billy Bones lodging at the Admiral Benbow.

queries.name: blind_messenger
queries.query: a sightless stranger presses a paper of condemnation into another man's hand
queries.note: Ch 3 — blind Pew delivers the black spot to Billy Bones.

queries.name: adrift_small_craft
queries.query: drifting helplessly alone at sea in a tiny fragile homemade craft tossed by the swell
queries.note: Ch 23-24 — Jim adrift in Ben Gunn's coracle.

queries.name: opening_the_sea_chest
queries.query: a boy and his mother unlock a dead lodger's heavy trunk to take only what they are owed
queries.note: Ch 4 - Jim and his mother open Billy Bones's chest.

queries.name: trampled_in_the_road
queries.query: riders come down the road at a gallop and a fleeing sightless beggar is knocked down and killed
queries.note: Ch 5 - Pew is ridden down by the revenue officers' horses.

queries.name: leaving_for_the_port
queries.query: the lad says goodbye to his home and travels to a busy harbour town where a vessel is being fitted out

queries.name: murder_in_the_marsh
queries.query: he watches from hiding as one crewman kills another with a blade among the boggy ground
queries.note: Ch 14 - Jim witnesses Silver murder Tom.

queries.name: assault_repelled
queries.query: the defenders inside the wooden walls fight off a rush of assailants and count their dead

queries.name: surgeon_tends_enemies
queries.query: having given his word of honour, the physician crosses over to treat the sick and injured among his foes

queries.name: dividing_the_fortune
queries.query: the survivors share out the wealth and each goes on to a different life back at home

queries.name: secret_council
queries.query: the trustworthy few gather quietly in the captain's quarters to decide how to handle the traitors

_criterion: REVISED 2026-07-26 after the first real run produced semantic 6/8 vs hash 3/8.
The original criterion capped the hash control at an ABSOLUTE 2/8. That was
wrong, because HashEmbedder is not noise: it hashes TOKENS into dimensions, so
a document sharing words with the query gets a higher cosine. It behaves as a
degenerate bag-of-words matcher with no IDF. Capping it absolutely therefore
measures how much incidental vocabulary a query shares with its answer, not
(That property is also the likely reason the production degradation went
unnoticed for so long: the fallback returns plausible-looking hits, not
The property actually worth asserting is PAIRED DOMINANCE: on the same query,
does the real embedder succeed where the degraded one fails? So we count
discordant pairs and apply a sign test.
semantic_only_hits >= 5 and hash_only_hits <= 1  =>  one-sided sign test
16 queries is the minimum that can clear p < 0.05 at all; the previous 8
could not, which is why the first run's 3-0 split gave only p = 0.125.
